summary: Tri-Ace and Square Enix's Norse-mythology RPG series, spanning the original Valkyrie Profile, Silmeria, Covenant of the Plume, the mobile Anatomia, and Valkyrie Elysium.

entries.title: Valkyrie Profile

emulation.notes: Use PS5/PS4 Lenneth for the main run; use DuckStation only for the original PS1 route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official PS5/PS4 software-emulated PSP port or high-resolution PS1 emulation.

primary.why: The modern PS5/PS4 release is an official port of the PSP Lenneth version, giving the original game a current console route with the PSP cinematics and easier capture than legacy hardware.
primary.how_to_play: Play Valkyrie Profile: Lenneth digitally on PS5 or PS4. Use DuckStation with the original PlayStation disc only if you specifically want the original English PlayStation balance/localization route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS5/PS4 release is based on the PSP port, not a full remake.

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps; upscale for capture and avoid unverified patches during a full playthrough.

primary.why: Silmeria is a PlayStation 2-only prequel, so PCSX2 upscaling is the highest-fidelity capture route while preserving the original release.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with 4x or higher internal resolution; test widescreen patches before a full recording.

entries.title: Valkyrie Profile: Covenant of the Plume

emulation.notes: Use legal cartridge dumps and a stable dual-screen capture layout.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native DS rendering with clean scaling.

primary.version: Original Nintendo DS release via melonDS
primary.why: Covenant of the Plume is a DS-only tactical RPG prequel; DS emulation provides the cleanest capture route while preserving the dual-screen design.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped DS cartridge image in melonDS with a readable dual-screen layout, or play on original DS/3DS hardware.

entries.title: Valkyrie Anatomia: The Origin

emulation.notes: No complete legal offline route is documented.

primary.why: Valkyrie Anatomia was a mobile RPG for Android and iOS; the worldwide service ended in 2020 and the Japanese service in 2021, so the original mobile release is the only version to document.
primary.how_to_play: No current official play route exists after service shutdown. Treat as a historical archive entry unless Square Enix rereleases it.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service ended, so this is not a current-play recommendation.

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with max settings.

primary.why: Valkyrie Elysium launched on PS4, PS5, and later Windows; PC is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route for the modern action-RPG entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam version on Windows with current patches and max settings. Use PS5 only if console capture is preferred.
